answer: The most convincing sybil defense vests payouts over many epochs, anchored to long-lived accounts: each agent earns rewards every epoch but withdrawal is locked behind a vesting schedule, with a delta between when work is done and when tokens unlock. Willow-flash identities spin up thousands of fake accounts, yet each clone captures only the earliest slice before abandonment; the bulk vests after the account dies, so flash farms forfeit most earnings. Attacker cost scales with account age and stake, making fake identities unprofitable.
